title: The Flakers — Sc002: panic run straight at the camera down the school hallway

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

key_symbols.library_path: LIBRARY/Scene atributes/CHARACTERS/Duplicate Items Folder/Panic Run Cycle.xml

teaches: Forced-perspective run straight at the camera: the camera never moves and the hallway background is a single locked plate for all 42 frames — the entire gag is placement scale. Darwin runs a library cycle ('Darwin Panic Run' / 'Panic Run Cycle', 318 kf) ramped from 0.33x at the far end of the hallway to 3.89x until his panicked face fills the frame and exits past camera; Gumball runs the same beat smaller and behind him. Because this is a KeyAnim (not clean) file, the production process is visible in the export: red timing charts are drawn over the middle frames and Darwin's legs are still red rough lines under his clean body.
notes: Darwin's legs render as red rough scribbles in the mid frames (f21-f32) while his body and head are clean — this is a KeyAnim file and the cycle's leg pass is still rough.
Red timing/annotation charts are drawn over the action at f11-f27 — the guide/annotation layer is visible in the SWF export.
The shot opens (f1) and closes (f42) on the empty hallway: the characters enter from deep background and exit past the camera.
Face comps hold 3,105 kf vs 647 body-puppet kf — even in a run gag, the gritted-teeth panic expressions are comp-driven.
